symptom: Every microflow with `notify workflow $Workflow;` written by mxcli fails the build: CE0166 "The 'Target' property is required" on the Notify workflow activity (11.10, 11.13; "'Activity'" on 11.6). `mxcli check` and `exec` passed
cause: A notify must name the element it reaches (NotifyTarget from 11.7, Activity before), and MDL had no clause for it; describe also omitted a stored target, so rewriting a Studio Pro microflow removed it
insight: The shipped statement was syntax for an action Mendix cannot build — nothing in the doctype tests or the skills exercised it, so it was never put through mx check. When a statement writes an action, check a Studio Pro-saved instance for properties the writer does not set: a required reference the grammar cannot express is a build failure waiting for the first user. The target's stored $Type depends on the element's kind, so resolve it against the workflow rather than asking the author to spell the type.
